title: Canonical header validity
statement: A bit string is canonically valid as a header exactly when it decodes as a pair and the canonical header extracted from it passes the bit-validity check.
caveat: The definitions of the pair decoder, canonical header, and bit-validity check are not included, so their exact meanings cannot be made more explicit.
